encoding_variations: 4506-T vs 4506-C — the IRS replaced the 4506-T with the 4506-C for third-party (IVES) transcript orders; line numbering differs (e.g. checkbox lines shift). form_revision disambiguates which line map to apply

checkbox lines — Return Transcript (line 6a), Account Transcript (6b), Record of Account (6c), Verification of Nonfiling (line 7), W-2/1099/1098/5498 (line 8); degrade booleans to str and keep the box label
TIN raw — entered in full by the borrower; not masked (unlike the resulting transcript)
entity signer — for business returns, a title/capacity line appears; capture it

open_questions.q: Years as a list vs flat string — years_or_periods_requested is date[] but <=4 tiny values
options: a nested flat-row list if a rule must iterate years
open_questions.recommendation: (a) flatten to one verbatim string — avoids ~5 sites of plumbing GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): BUILD IT — LP-437 made nested lists cheap (one declaration + the generic mechanism); the one-list-budget / defer / no-consumer concern is overturned. Build as flat_row; the per-rule consumer is separate follow-up.

open_questions.q: Raw-SSN handling — this form is a rare place a full unmasked SSN appears; confirm registration as raw PII (pre_masked false) so the snapshot masks it; verify the catch-all cannot receive it
open_questions.recommendation: register raw (snapshot masks + hashes), consistent with recipient_tin GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: No attached rule — 0 rules; the form primarily documents that transcripts were authorized/ordered; confirm whether a completeness rule (attestation checked, signature within 120 days, correct boxes) is planned so the checkbox/signature fields have a consumer
open_questions.recommendation: confirm whether a completeness/validity rule is planned

notes: Serves 0 rules — no rule in the packet names this document; it is the borrower's signed IRS authorization to release transcripts. Fields justified by identity, PII, and processor use.
21 typed-core rows — within target. No rule floor, but the form is dense with PII and processor/compliance checkboxes; the selections and signature date are what a completeness/validity check reads.

PII: three fields need _PII_FIELDS registration (none registered under these names) — taxpayer_tin (pre_masked false, critical: the 4506-T/4506-C prints the full unmasked SSN; register raw so the snapshot masks + hashes, consistent with recipient_tin), spouse_tin (pre_masked false, full spouse SSN), taxpayer_phone (pre_masked false, borderline PII but the borrower's personal number — flag for review).
